claim: Concurrency race: two concurrent runs of one tool overwrite the fixed scratch path while the first subprocess is still reading it (High).
reason: Not reachable in the live build. There is one uvicorn worker and run_tool blocks the event loop, so two runs can never overlap in the process; verified: two concurrent 3 s runs finished at 3.02 s and 6.04 s. Both interpreters also read the whole script before executing. The hazard only appears once execution is moved off the loop (BUG-004), so that fix must also use per-run paths (folded into BUG-015).

claim: Race between the .complete marker check and staging.rename(destination) in ensure_dependencies.
reason: The marker check, the destination.exists() check and the rename all execute while the per-digest exclusive fcntl lock is held, so no second installer for the same digest can interleave. Different digests use different destinations.

Mechanism confirmed and merged into BUG-001, but for a single-user LAN deployment with container hardening it is rated high (rebind race must be won, browser local-network protections are tightening). Critical only if exposed or tunnelled.
By design: the endpoint returns no secrets and the dashboard needs it; it only mirrors what README and the dashboard already state. The 422-echo half of SEC-12 is kept (BUG with BE-23).

claim: Separate frontend finding that Run / Test blocks the server.
reason: Not refuted; it is the same defect as BE-01 and is merged into BUG-004 to avoid double counting.

claim: Medium-severity service-worker update and offline-page defects.
reason: Confirmed in code and on the HTTPS scratch copy, but the live deployment is a plain-HTTP LAN origin where the service worker never registers (verified: isSecureContext=false on a non-localhost http origin), so they cannot trigger today. Kept as P3.

claim: Legacy rows might store language values ('python', 'js') the new studio select cannot show.
reason: Checked the 42a5dd1 dashboard: its select already used python3/node, so no such rows can exist. Dropped.
No defect claims beyond those already merged (R3 transport -> BUG with BE-04/BE-18/BE-19/BE-20; I1 schema editor -> studio schema bug; I9 dead config -> release hygiene bug). Nothing refuted.
